transitions.idle: query.all_animations_finished && (t.current_time = query.time_stamp; t.result = t.current_time - v.last_time <= 1? 0 : 1;v.last_time = t.current_time;return t.result);

transitions.equipping: t.current_time = query.time_stamp; t.result = t.current_time - v.last_time <= 1? 0 : 1;v.last_time = t.current_time;return t.result;
